summary: Verified the new panel measurement tool end-to-end in the fullscreen 3D viewer. All acceptance criteria pass: admin login, opening TagSheet with thumbnail, entering fullscreen, activating 'Medir' mode with hint, drawing markers/line between two raycast points with mm result (3187 mm shown), 'Limpiar' clears the result, and toggling 'Medir' off exits measure mode and hides the hint/result.
critical_code_review_comments: usePanelScene: onMeasure is included in the effect dependency array; since PanelFullscreen wraps it in useCallback([]) it is stable, but any future inline handler would re-init the entire three.js scene. Fine as-is.
unitScale heuristic (maxDim>100 ? 1 : 1000) correctly yields mm for the mesh sizes (2.99x5.72 m). Consider making this explicit via a prop from backend metadata if unit ambiguity ever grows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Measurement tool validated on panel C1 [6420986] at 1920x1080. First click near canvas center + second click offset (200,100) hit the mesh and returned 3187 mm. Toggle labels swap 'Medir' <-> 'Medición activa', hint transitions from 'Toca dos puntos del panel para medir' -> 'Toca el segundo punto para medir' -> result. Limpiar removed the result and restored the hint; deactivating measure mode removed the entire hint panel.
